{{EventEnd|date = 4th of December 2021}} {{For|other uses of [[Frost_(Disambiguation)|Frost]]}} {{EventInfobox |title1 = Frost Invasion Event |image1=WinterThumbnail.png |dates = 8 May 2021 – 4 December 2021 |tracks = 1 |previous_event = [[Halloween 2020 Event|Halloween 2020]] |next_event = [[Solar Eclipse Event|Solar Eclipse]] |previous_pass = [[Halloween 2020 Event#Halloween Season|Halloween]] |next_pass = [[Solar Eclipse Event#Solar Eclipse Season Pass|Solar Eclipse]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Frost Invasion Event''' was the seventh event to be added to Tower Defense Simulator (alongside the [[Metaverse Champions Event]]). This event brought one new event tower, the [[Sledger]]. The event had a season pass, which required {{Shards|Shards}} to reach higher tiers. Unlike the [[Halloween 2020 Event]], you can earn {{Shards|Shards}} outside of this event. The event began on the 8th of May 2021, and concluded on 4th of December 2021. ==Frost Invasion Season Pass== [[File:Battlepass0.png|center|500px|thumb]] You could obtain {{Shards|Shards}} from playing games. 1 Total |} ==Badges== {{Badge |title = Frost Invasion 2021 |description = Send the Frost Spirit back to its realm... |rewards = [[Sledger]], {{Exp|400}}Reward no longer obtainable. |image = Winter2020.png |obtainable = No }} ==Official Event Trailer== [[File:Tower Defense Simulator Frost Invasion Trailer|thumb|750px|center]] ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} WinterThumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} FrostInvasion.png FrostUpdateIcon.png }} ==Trivia== *The '''Frost Invasion Event''' was the first event to be released alongside another event, that being the [[Metaverse Champions Event]]. **This and the [[Metaverse Champions Event]] are the second pair of events to be playable at the same time, the first pair being the [[SFOTH Event]] and the [[Area 51 Event]]. *This event was originally called the ''Winter 2020 Event''. However, due to delays causing it to be released in early May, it was renamed to the ''Frost Invasion Event''. *The '''Frost Invasion Event''' is the final event to fully use [[Elevators]] for starting matches, since [[Matchmaking]] would be used for all events since the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], which came right after this event. **Although Event [[Elevators]] were briefly brought back with the [[Null & Void Event]], they were replaced with matchmaking shortly after, and the majority of that event relied on [[Matchmaking]]. *The map for the '''Frost Invasion Event''' was originally planned to be [[Winterfall]] and then [[Frozen Battlefront]] but they were never implemented for this event as they were both scrapped. *This was the longest running event in the game, surpassing the [[Halloween 2020 Event]] on the 15th of November 2021. It was available to play for 210 days. *This event was later remade as the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. **In the game's lore, the events of this event are no longer considered canon as they have been replaced by the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. *Prior to the 16th of May 2021, the amount of {{Shards|Shards}} gained on each wave were: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align:center; margin:0 auto;" |- !Mode !Shards Reward |- |'''Normal''' |{{Shards|25}} x (Waves/30)^1.75 |- |'''Molten''' |{{Shards|50}} x (Waves/40)^1.75 |- |'''Fallen''' |{{Shards|80}} x (Waves/40)^1.75 |- |'''Hardcore''' |{{Shards|100}} x (Waves/50)^1.75 |} ==Notes== {{EventNavBox}} [[Category:Passes]]
